snippet.title: Reality Drift - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Reality Drift will be released on 11 November 2026 for PC.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078120/Reality_Drift/

Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive! 

Drive through a series of strange worlds, racing to be the first to deliver packages to obnoxious godlike creatures who have nothing but disdain for you. At the end of each track, choose between three options for a new track - you'll decide based on your stats and the linked upgrades being offered.

Developer: Arganoid Industries
X: https://x.com/arganoidI/
